regions.name: crt-monitor
regions._t141: Row-1 col-2 desk cell (monitor-on/terminal-glow state), cropped to the monitor+keyboard+mouse unit only, NOT the desk it sits on (desk is its own separately-shipped sprite, group 'desk', so stage 2 composes them). The unit touches the desk surface with no magenta gap in the source art, so a thin sliver of desk-colored pixels along the bottom edge is unavoidable at this crop; the box is chosen to minimize it, not eliminate it.

_comment: Sheet path is relative to projects/bureau/references/office/ in the brain (GET /api/knowledge?file=projects/bureau/references/office/<sheet>&raw=1) — download it there first, the reference sheets are not committed to git. Re-run: python3 hub/tools/rectify.py <this-file> --out-dir /tmp/check (after adjusting 'sheet' to your local download path) and diff the sha256 in ../reports/report-desk.json against this set's own sprite hashes. Three groups, three independent palettes (desk / chair / crt-monitor) per THE PALETTE LAW — never shared across subjects.
